headline: A phased cutover sequences viable capabilities and checks readiness at each wave.
rationale: Each cutover decision combines process, data, control, user, and technical evidence before legacy work is retired.
step_1_body: Identify viable slices, hidden dependencies, and fallback paths.
step_2_body: Profile data; draft tests, runbooks, communications, and support plans.
step_3_body: Reconcile outcomes, flag exceptions, and trace anomalies.
governance_note: OWNERS APPROVE GO / NO-GO, FALLBACK, DATA CHANGES, RISK ACCEPTANCE, AND RETIREMENT; ANALYSIS SURFACES EVIDENCE.
migration_unit_note: A business-viable capability slice is the unit of migration.
